# Pull request

## Summary

Describe the user-visible change and why it is needed.

## Verification

- [ ] `npm run check` passes locally.
- [ ] New behavior has focused test coverage.
- [ ] Documentation reflects any changed behavior or data boundary.
- [ ] No secrets, private coordinates, generated output, or dependency directories are included.
- [ ] Energy values are still clearly labeled as simulated unless a reviewed telemetry adapter is introduced.

## Visual evidence

Add sanitized before/after images for visual changes.
